She stops and looks back over her shoulder with a neutral expression. The camera zooms into the handbag resting on the stairs. A cut shows a grand stained-glass dome ceiling with ornate moldings and white architecture. (2) The scene shifts to the woman leaning against a dark wood-paneled corner where red lighting flashes over her before returning to natural indoor light. She sits on the stairs, clutching the bag, and then spins in a hallway with a checkered black-and-white floor. Close-up shots highlight the bag's leather texture and the embossed Gucci logo on her jacket as she peeks from behind a door. (3) The woman poses on the banister of a grand staircase, resting her head on her hand with a pensive expression. A close-up shows her black leather boots with embossed logos against the stone floor. She walks away from the camera in a wide hallway, then turns and walks back with a slight smile. The final shot shows her sitting on the stairs, resting her chin on her hand.
